client_contract: Graph objects organize external language patterns and internal features; datasets are versioned evidence filters. Bind run+full snapshot+report+graph+case index; preserve counterexamples and superseded revisions. No total deciphering percentage.
motivation: Six coordinates show answer-aligned conditional responses; no individual switch or fixed property has been established.
question: Separate world fact, question relation, abstract decision and lexical answer, then explain a small heldout-predictive subgraph.

stages.design: cross fact × question polarity × answer coding (Yes/No, independently permuted arbitrary codes, another language), names/keys/frames/length balanced; new source-disjoint backgrounds
stages.entry_gate: discovery-only behavioral calibration; per-cell sample size, cluster unit, effect size and FWER/power fixed before confirm/lockbox

stages.boundary: dictionary directions are not native neurons; no one-coordinate-one-concept assumption; resource plan before all-token collection
stages.design: same frozen inputs compare native G/V/A, a locally trained sparse dictionary/transcoder and supervised token/position baselines; fit only discovery; retain all-coordinate views

stages.boundary: do not infer necessity from large local terms or a null last-query edit; retain negative controls, finite intervals and capability NI
stages.design: arithmetic head→G/V→A→residual/logit sources; separate question-end, assistant query and historical cue positions; predeclared local ablation/control/rescue tests

stages.boundary: no target-layer state, future token, answer label or full original forward may be a predictor input
stages.design: features/edges learned on discovery predict unseen frame/entity/code activations and next-token distribution; report heldout KL and loss recovery against lexical, position and n-gram baselines

stages.boundary: full model snapshot and precision separate; native coordinates not equated across models
stages.design: content-addressed job input/output, source-split shards, cross-node canary/audit, then sequential local Qwen3-14B/GLM4 comparisons
